description:
*Objective:* Verify that a book with zero stock cannot be added to the cart and the user is told it is out of stock.

*Type:* negative  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* A regular user account is available
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* An admin account is available
* No zero-stock book exists in the seeded catalog, so the case creates its own as admin
* A unique title is built from the current date and time (call it the QA title)

*Test data:*
* New book: QA title, author "QA Author", price 9.99, stock 0
* Quantity to add: 1

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the admin account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button and the Admin button are visible
# Open the Admin dashboard and the Books tab  
   *Expected:* The "Add New Book" form is visible
# Fill title (QA title), author "QA Author", price 9.99, stock 0 (tick a category if the form requires one) and click Add Book  
   *Expected:* The book list shows a card with the QA title, price $9.99 and "Stock: 0"
# Click Logout  
   *Expected:* Session ends; the Login button is visible
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; the cart badge in the navigation is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "\[QA title\]" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "\[QA title\]" is listed
# Open the detail page of "\[QA title\]"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "\[QA title\]"; an out-of-stock indicator is shown
# Try to click Add to Cart (it may be disabled)  
   *Expected:* An "Out of stock" message is visible or the button is disabled with that text; cart badge absent or 0
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty and does not list the QA book

*Postconditions:*
* Cart is empty
* The QA book is deleted by an admin afterwards

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
* Related bug: REF-29

*Notes:*
* The application shows a disabled "Out of Stock" button rather than a message; rejection wording is taken from the requirement.
title: Reject adding an out-of-stock book
